run_forced_alignment: run the UnitY2F2ForcedAligner to align a speech waveform with text and get word-level timestamps
create_aligner_config: create a UnitY2F2ForcedAlignerConfig with custom aligner name, device, and fps settings
process_utterance_with_text: process a waveform and text through process_utterance to produce a prosodically annotated Utterance with word boundaries
process_utterance_with_words: process a waveform and word list through process_utterance to get aligned word segments and pause lengths
get_cached_tokenizer: get a cached word tokenizer for a given language using the lru_cache decorated get_word_tokenizer method
